admission_transition.name: stego-service-inspection.hypershell-namespace-allocation.allocation
admission_transition.scope: One address replacement in the Gateway admission variable. All other cluster fields remain equal.

remaining: Run the complete public Gateway workflow with the address-change fixture after the active CNPG run ends and cleanup is verified.
Verify new-address access, old-address denial, worker restart, namespace recovery, unchanged generation, and complete cleanup.
Use any application failure to determine the next common STEGO change.
limits: This fixture uses fixed IP addresses. It does not prove DNS tracking or RDS failover.
The test Pod must not supply operator policy or gain admission-policy write permission.
No DNS provider or Technology Preview feature was enabled.

workflow_implementation.go_checks: Selected endpoint input, per-instance telemetry, and invalid Gateway checks passed against the generated fixture.
workflow_implementation.operator: A fixed request changes one generated policy with UID, resourceVersion, and original-spec conditions. Lost responses are checked against the same journal and policy.
workflow_implementation.workflow: Both generated workers restart with the replacement binding. Fresh connections check both addresses before the change, after it, and after recovery.
workflow_implementation.telemetry: Require every expected worker instance, including both endpoint-change restarts.
workflow_implementation.evidence: Require the operator acknowledgement, completed journal, traffic record, and generation records.
